title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘the Commission finding that the RRF has led to a sustained increase in investments across the EU and’ and ‘given its synergies with other EU funds; is, however, concerned that the RRF expiration in 2026 poses a significant risk of a substantial decline in public investment in common European priorities;’
